rules: damage geometry, ship mobility, deck function and air-group readiness are separate clocks
historical repair cases are analogues only

Cabot_CVL28.centered_damage: One aerial torpedo; severe enough for campaign mission kill but not sinking.
Cabot_CVL28.2Feb_evening: Flooding/fire controlled centered; withdrawal speed roughly 17-20 kt with 2-3 escort destroyer-class slots.
Cabot_CVL28.flight_deck: No normal combat cycle. Airborne survivors cross-deck; remaining flyable aircraft are not assumed instantly transferable.
Cabot_CVL28.immediate_risk: Probable eastward withdrawal corridor is a plausible Japanese submarine cripple-hunt target.
Cabot_CVL28.return_band: late April to mid-May full fast-carrier service centered early May unless later survey changes damage geometry.

Intrepid_CV11.centered_damage: One bomb plus splinter damage; propulsion/steering/major fuel systems intact centered.
Intrepid_CV11.constraint: Air-group losses, crew fatigue and cross-deck congestion remain even after deck repair.

Hiryu.centered_damage: One bomb plus damaging near miss; flight operations suspended, propulsion/waterline retained.
Hiryu.underway: Stays with protected carrier formation through the daylight danger period; emergency deck clearing/shoring during withdrawal.
Hiryu.carrier_team_gate: late Feb centered; lost attack leaders/navigators are not repaired with deck plate.
